info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v3-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts API provides access to a comprehensive list of available discounts associated with auto insurance quotes. By leveraging this API, consumers can easily identify potential savings when obtaining quotes, allowing for more informed decision-making regarding insurance purchases. This resource is primarily intended for insurance companies, agents, and consumers looking to explore discount options. Utilize this endpoint to enhance your offerings and customer engagement by presenting tailored discounts based on user profiles and preferences.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch discounts that can be applied to quotes. It provides information on available discounts based on specific criteria, helping users optimize their quotes with potential savings.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving quote discounts. This request accepts a JSON payload containing parameters that define the query for obtaining applicable discounts on quotes.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of discounts.
